required_behavior: Load governed source artifacts as read-only files.
prohibited_behavior: Writing to source artifacts, governance artifacts, or Shiny-generated replacement data.
governance_rationale: Dashboard must not mutate audited outputs.

contract_rule: Shiny must not compute or recalculate MASE/RMSSE.
prohibited_behavior: Recomputing MASE, RMSSE, aggregation, significance, or new scores.
Running forecasts, model code, tournament code, or scoring code.

contract_rule: Shiny must not infer a champion from tournament rank alone.
prohibited_behavior: Treating preliminary position as champion decision.
governance_rationale: Tournament standing is evidence, not decision.

contract_rule: Shiny must display champion decision as CHAMPION_SELECTED_WITH_CONDITIONS.
prohibited_behavior: Upgrading decision to champion_selected or winner.

required_behavior: Show medium confidence near champion decision.

contract_rule: Shiny must display ETS Explicit conditions.
required_behavior: Show champion conditions C-001 through C-005.

prohibited_behavior: Hiding FastNeuralAR_MLP or calling it discarded.

contract_rule: Shiny must display NBEATS/NHITS deferred status.
required_behavior: Show runtime/dependency deferral as future work.
prohibited_behavior: Hiding deferred models or saying permanently rejected.

contract_rule: Shiny must display audit status and carry-forward conditions.
required_behavior: Show Audit #5 approve-with-conditions and governed F-010 correction.

contract_rule: Shiny must not say ETS Explicit won or is absolute best model.
prohibited_behavior: Winner, absolute best, replaces all others, no caveats.

contract_rule: Shiny must trace displayed facts to artifacts.
required_behavior: Use dashboard bindings and source paths.

contract_rule: Shiny must not silently filter risks, deferred models, or ineligible models.
required_behavior: Any display filter must keep risk/deferred visibility available.
prohibited_behavior: Dropping FastNeuralAR_MLP, NBEATS, NHITS, or risk rows from governance sections.

contract_rule: Shiny must disclose metric and governance methodology.
required_behavior: Show metrics are sourced from Model Lab and not recomputed.
prohibited_behavior: Presenting dashboard metrics as live recalculations.
